candidates.name: Angiosarcoma
support_spans: concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells present around small vessels
candidates.why: The presence of a tender, enlarging scalp lesion with overlying vessels and the histopathological findings of concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells around small vessels support this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Kaposi sarcoma
contradict_spans: Negative staining for: ... Kaposi sarcoma–associated herpesvirus
candidates.why: The patient's history of multiple squamous cell carcinomas and the presence of a tender, enlarging scalp lesion could suggest Kaposi sarcoma, but the negative staining for Kaposi sarcoma–associated herpesvirus contradicts this diagnosis.
